sketchMechanisms: The Maybe monad's >>= operator silently propagates Nothing through a chain of computations, so once any step yields Nothing, every subsequent step is skipped without error.
A generator with yield that is never iterated — the function body is defined but its code never actually executes until someone calls next().
A LEFT JOIN where the right table has no matching rows, producing NULLs for every column of the absent side — the structure of what's missing is preserved.
